cc:Work.dc:description: Two panels show blue and rust classes. A straight line separates two clusters in the first panel but crosses both interleaved spiral classes in the second.

g.text: One straight boundary cannot unwind a spiral.

g.text: Geometry can make the same learning rule succeed or fail.
